# DiveAtlas — Best Places to Scuba Dive
> Data-driven directory of the 27 best scuba diving destinations worldwide. Visibility, water temperature, marine life, budget, season, and difficulty compared on every page.

## Site
- [Home — Best Places to Scuba Dive](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/): Data-ranked top picks, destination finder, map, and browse categories
- [All Destinations](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/): Every rated dive destination in the directory
- [About DiveAtlas](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/about/): Methodology, data sources, and editorial standards
- [Contact](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/contact/): Corrections, data questions, and suggestions
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/privacy/): How visitor data is handled
- [Terms of Use](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/terms/): Terms for using the content

## Browse by Ocean
- [Pacific](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/ocean/pacific/): Coral Triangle and the richest reefs
- [Indian](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/ocean/indian/): Maldives, Seychelles, Thailand
- [Caribbean](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/ocean/caribbean/): Blue Hole, Cozumel, Bonaire
- [Red Sea](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/ocean/red-sea/): World-class wrecks, vibrant walls
- [Atlantic](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/ocean/atlantic/): Azores to Fernando de Noronha

## Browse by Experience
- [Beginner](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/experience/beginner/): Gentle currents, easy shore dives
- [Intermediate](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/experience/intermediate/): Moderate currents, deeper profiles
- [Advanced](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/experience/advanced/): Drifts, deep walls, pelagic action
- [Liveaboard](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/experience/liveaboard/): Multi-day remote atoll safaris

## Browse by Marine Life
- [Sharks](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/marine-life/sharks/): Hammerheads, tigers, bulls
- [Manta Rays](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/marine-life/manta-rays/)
- [Whale Sharks](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/marine-life/whale-sharks/)
- [Turtles](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/marine-life/turtles/)
- [Coral Reefs](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/marine-life/coral-reefs/)
- [Macro Life](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/marine-life/macro/): Muck diving capitals, critter hotspots

## Browse by Budget
- [Budget](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/price/budget/): Under $100/day
- [Mid-Range](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/price/mid-range/): $100–200/day
- [Premium](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/price/premium/): $200–400/day
- [Luxury](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/price/luxury/): $400+/day

## Browse by Month
- [January](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/month/1/) through [December](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/browse/month/12/): Peak destinations for each month

## Top Destinations
- [Raja Ampat](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/raja-ampat/): The epicenter of marine biodiversity
- [Galapagos Islands](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/galapagos/): Big-animal diving at Darwin and Wolf
- [Maldives](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/maldives/): Accessible luxury, mantas and whale sharks
- [Great Barrier Reef](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/great-barrier-reef/): The world's largest living structure
- [Palau](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/palau/): Blue Corner, Jellyfish Lake
- [Komodo](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/destinations/komodo/): Currents, mantas, and dragons

## Tools

- [World Map](https://www.best-places-to-scuba-dive.com/map/): Every destination on an interactive map

## Key Facts
- Best overall destination: Raja Ampat, Indonesia (widely considered #1 for marine biodiversity, 1,500+ fish species)
- Best for beginners: Bonaire, Cozumel, Maldives, Great Barrier Reef
- Best big-animal diving: Galapagos and Cocos Island
- Each destination rated on seven weighted criteria: marine life, coral health, visibility, accessibility, seasonal reliability, value, uniqueness
